# checkmk_contact_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK contact group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a contact group by name
data "checkmk_contact_group" "example" {
  name = "admins"
}

output "contact_group_alias" {
  value = data.checkmk_contact_group.example.alias
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the contact group to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String) Human-readable alias for the contact group.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the contact group (same as name).
